# Master inventory of Ukrainian institutions (reconciled)

**Generated by** `site/scripts/make-master-inventory.py` from the university records, the landscape and gap-discovery files in `research/universities/` and the SEMrush exports in `research/semrush/`. **Machine-readable copy:** `research/universities/MASTER_INVENTORY.json`.

**Totals:** 47 institutions; 17 listed in the working directory as "Not yet verified" research previews (names only, noindex, outside the sitemap); 29 in the private register only; 1 rejected. **Verified claims: 0.** Every city, ownership, programme and status statement below is a search-result lead: no official page has been read, because the official hosts are refused by the network policy.

**How institutions were deduplicated:** by official name, then former names and transliterations (Odessa/Odesa, Kharkov/Kharkiv, Kiev/Kyiv, Lvov/Lviv, Zaporozhye/Zaporizhzhia, Vinnitsa/Vinnytsia, Uzhgorod/Uzhhorod, Lugansk/Luhansk, Cherkassy/Cherkasy), then official domain. Two names that look alike but are different institutions stay separate: Kharkiv National Medical University and V. N. Karazin Kharkiv National University; Zaporizhzhia State Medical and Pharmaceutical University and Zaporizhzhia National University; Kyiv Medical University (private), Bogomolets National Medical University and Taras Shevchenko National University of Kyiv; the Ukrainian Luhansk State Medical University (reported in Rivne) and the institution in occupied Luhansk; the private Lviv Medical University (formerly Lviv Medical Institute) and Danylo Halytsky Lviv National Medical University; Kharkiv Institute of Medicine and Biomedical Sciences and Kharkiv International Medical University; Odesa I. I. Mechnikov National University ("Odesa National University") and Odesa National Medical University; Oles Honchar Dnipro National University and Dnipro State Medical University.

**Checks** (an independent skeptic's re-check of the leads, where one was done): **N** name and domain agree across two independent results; **G** a government or authority result lists it; **P** an official page shows a programme for foreign applicants; **Q** an unresolved relocation, occupation, closure, merger or licence question. "listed earlier" = one of the original 12, listed under N25 before checks existed; "not re-checked" = researched, but the skeptic re-check did not run (verifier usage limit) or the entry is a single directory-title lead. **Demand:** SEMrush exact match (`phrase_these`), highest variant per database (in = India, uk, ng, pk, ae, za); not additive across spellings.
